chunks: And in the narration of Abī al-Ḥusayn Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Asadī, may Allah be pleased with him, al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام said:
Do not bear witness for one who divorces contrary to the sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the sunnah (prophetic tradition), meaning the prescribed lawful way
key_terms.لِغَيْرِ: in a manner other than or contrary to

ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim bear witness to a divorce performed contrary to the sunnah (prophetic tradition)?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers not to validate a divorce carried out in a manner contrary to the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It emphasizes adherence to lawful procedure in family matters and the moral and legal responsibility of witnesses.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3350 - In a narration from Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him), Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Do not bear witness for one who divorces contrary to the Sunnah."
